source.figure_table: Abstract of the Townes humanized mouse model paper (per-cell F-cell proportion over time)

context.model: Townes humanized knock-in mouse model (human γβAS βS globin genes)

observation.assay: γ-globin mRNA in erythroid tissues under hydroxyurea

note: γ-globin RNA augmentation in erythroid tissues under HU not quantified — the abstract reports a 'lack of augmentation' and attributes the apparent HbF increase to erythropoiesis suppression (myelosuppressive toxicity of HU). Gap: no quantitative γ-globin values; the decoupling with F-cell elevation is the key observation (spec seed 1: 'Capture how persistent F-cell elevation and sustained RNA induction diverged in this model').
